about.text: produced in a similar manner to caciocavallo

sources.text: Basilicata; pasta filata like caciocavallo, rind rubbed with olive oil. Not itself protected: the PGI belongs to the separate Canestrato di Moliterno. Pecorino di Moliterno is sheep-only and hard
